content:
**Fish Bits** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* update. 

Fish Bits restore only a tiny amount of HP and hunger. They can be used as ingredients in other dishes, such as Fish and Tatos, Fish Chowder, or Grilled Fish. Another use is to feed them to Linda-Lee, by using her Chum Trough at Fisherman's Rest, upon which Linda-Lee will belch out a random Legendary armor or weapon for every 25 Fish Bits fed to her.

Fish Bits can only be crafted from caught fish at Cooking Stations, with the amount of bits obtained depending on factors such as size and rarity:

| 1 Fish Bit | 
|---|
| 2 Fish Bits | 
| 4 Fish Bits | 
| 5 Fish Bits | 
| 10 Fish Bits | 
| 25 Fish Bits | 

Can only be crafted by the player.

The Super Duper perk can affect the amount of Fish Bits crafted.

An unused variant, Glowing Fish Bits, can be found in the game files. [1]
